description: This Python script performs system benchmarking focused on OpenGL performance and Kivy UI component creation, including system info, OpenGL info, and various widget creation and dispatch benchmarks.

classes.name: FakeMotionEvent
classes.description: A subclass of MotionEvent used for simulating touch events in benchmarks.

classes.name: bench_widget_creation
classes.description: Benchmark class for creating 10,000 Widget instances.

classes.name: bench_widget_creation_with_root
classes.description: Benchmark class for creating a root widget and adding 10,000 child widgets.

classes.name: bench_widget_draw
classes.description: Benchmark class for drawing a widget tree with 10,000 widgets.

classes.name: bench_widget_dispatch
classes.description: Benchmark class for dispatching touch events across a widget hierarchy.

classes.name: bench_label_creation
classes.description: Benchmark class for creating 10,000 Label widgets with random text.

classes.name: bench_button_creation
classes.description: Benchmark class for creating 10,000 Button widgets with random text.

classes.name: bench_label_creation_with_tick
classes.description: Benchmark class for creating labels with Clock.tick() call.

classes.name: bench_button_creation_with_tick
classes.description: Benchmark class for creating buttons with Clock.tick() call.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Method in each benchmark class to execute the benchmark.
